title: Adding and subtracting fractions
status: draft: written by Claude, waiting for owner review
about: Teacher-verified mastery check. Written separately from the practice generators: different wordings (sum, take away from, missing number, three fractions) and word problems. Each item is worth 1 point. 'math' is the calculation behind the item, used only by the test that checks the answer key.
directions: Show your work. Write each answer in simplest form. Mixed numbers or improper fractions are both fine.

items.prompt: What fraction goes in the box?  {3/10} + ☐ = {4/5}
A recipe uses {3/4} cup of flour for the dough and {2/3} cup for the topping. How much flour is that in all?
A board is {7/8} of a yard long. Mia cuts off {1/3} of a yard. How long is the piece that's left?
What fraction goes in the box?  ☐ + {1/6} = {5/8}
Jordan walked {2/5} of a mile to a friend's house, then {1/2} of a mile to the park. How far did Jordan walk in all?
A water bottle held {5/6} of a liter. After practice, {3/8} of a liter is left. How much water was drunk?
